text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Monthly drift level (points of effective capacity) of fits made with data to 30 June 2025, in the 11:00 to 15:59 hour band. A forecast holds the last value (diamonds, at the cut). Each fit's level is centred on its own profile, so the shape is comparable and the height is not.'
text.tspan: Monthly drift level (points of effective capacity) of fits made with data to 30 June 2025, in
the 11:00 to 15:59 hour band. A forecast holds the last value (diamonds, at the cut). Each
fit's level is centred on its own profile, so the shape is comparable and the height is not.
